diagram_math_checks.result: For each q>=0, E_P=H^q Hom(P_bullet(M),N), E_I=H^q Hom(M,I^bullet(N)), T=H^q Tot Hom(P_bullet(M),I^bullet(N)). j_P:E_P->T is induced by N->I(N); j_I:E_I->T is induced by P(M)->M. Both point into T, as in the local balance theorem Statement and Verification 2.1. The second row uses precisely (M',N').

Writing A:P(M')->P(M) and B:I(N)->I(N') for the supplied lifts, the total map sends f to B f A. The projective edge map sends f:P(M)->N to b f A:P(M')->N'; the injective edge map sends g:M->I(N) to B g a:M'->I(N'). These give exactly the three downward arrows. This checks contravariance in M and covariance in N against Verification 1.1 and both Ext definitions.

The lifting identities B eta_N=eta_N' b and epsilon_M A=a epsilon_M' make T(a,b) j_P=j_P' E_P(a,b) and T(a,b) j_I=j_I' E_I(a,b), respectively; these are the two squares asserted by Verification 2.1 and supplier proposition Proof 2.1. Since both j maps are cohomology isomorphisms, beta=j_I^{-1}j_P gives E_I(a,b) beta_M,N=beta_M',N' E_P(a,b). No new relation or sign convention is introduced.
